answer: TLS client certificate per identity is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 404 pays 7272 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. What carries the cedar here is verification, the wander of cost is what stops the farm, and the vertex of the record keeps every claim checkable. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
